1. Game asset use: Identify the phase's one decisive action: start night or sunburst.
2. Runtime size and safe area: output [512, 384] pixels, Godot display [160, 114] pixels. Full artwork must fill canvas with 8px outer transparent margin; no cropping; content safe margins left/top/right/bottom [28, 25, 28, 32].
3. Project visual anchor: res://Design/Sunflower-Defense-Art-Style-Guide.md; res://tmp/battle-ui-v3-baseline/hud-day-runtime.png; res://assets/ui/generated/battle_hud/runtime_primary_action_normal_v2.png. Deep ink-green glass, thin oxidized aged brass, sparse leaf engraving, warm upper-left highlights, botanical storybook brushwork.
4. Composition and state contract: One horizontal rounded rectangular greenhouse action frame, aspect 4:3. Stable narrow brass edge, sparse leaf relief only in corners; empty ink-green glass center, no icons. Orthographic UI view; upper-left soft light. Identical silhouette for all states; only tint and rim luminance change at runtime.
5. Comfort: Low contrast centers; restrained warm highlights without bloom; Sparse edge engraving; no flashing or motion implied; Clear silhouettes at 160 and 176 pixels; quiet runtime text areas.
6. Project and AI exclusions: pixel art; photography; candy saturation; neon; chrome; plastic; dense decoration; baked UI; text; watermark; logo; no text, no watermark, no logo, no unintended objects, no baked UI, no alternatives or contact sheet.
7. Transparent output: real RGBA transparent exterior, clean unpremultiplied alpha edges, no solid backdrop, checkerboard or environment.。
布局：One horizontal rounded rectangular greenhouse action frame, aspect 4:3. Stable narrow brass edge, sparse leaf relief only in corners; empty ink-green glass center, no icons. Orthographic UI view; upper-left soft light. Identical silhouette for all states; only tint and rim luminance change at runtime.。
状态一致性：One generated master; button hover/pressed/disabled derive from its exact alpha; bezel remains neutral。
舒适度约束：Low contrast centers; restrained warm highlights without bloom；Sparse edge engraving; no flashing or motion implied；Clear silhouettes at 160 and 176 pixels; quiet runtime text areas。
不得生成：pixel art、photography、candy saturation、neon、chrome、plastic、dense decoration、baked UI、text、watermark、logo。
禁止任何可读或伪造的文字、字母、数字、签名和水印；文字由 Godot 字体系统绘制。
输出为真实透明 PNG；禁止棋盘格、白底、纯色背景和背景底板。
